title: The Past Conditional: -tt volna (Unfulfilled Past Conditions)

sections.title: Forming the Past Conditional
sections.content: To express actions that would have happened in the past under counterfactual conditions, Hungarian adds the invariant auxiliary particle *volna* to the standard past tense verb form: *Ha tudtam volna, eljöttem volna* (If I had known, I would have come).

items.spanish: Ha időben szóltál volna, segítettünk volna neked.
items.english: If you had spoken in time, we would have helped you.

items.spanish: Ha nem esett volna az eső, a szabadban sétáltunk volna.
items.english: If it hadn't rained, we would have walked outdoors.

items.spanish: Biztosan megértette volna a döntésünket, ha elmagyarázzuk.
items.english: He surely would have understood our decision if we had explained it.
